rule: For every book/*.md excluding README.md, bibliography.md and FULL.md, every nonblank stripped line of that chapter appears as a stripped nonblank line in FULL.md, matching papers/oi_lattice_code/mirror_check.py.
evidence_method: GitHub connector exact source bytes; FULL Git blob read because its normal contents endpoint exceeds the API's text-content size limit; compared trimmed nonblank chapter lines against a set of trimmed nonblank FULL lines in read-only batches.
limitations: Does not run the original mirror_check.py process in a full checkout. Its exact source logic was reimplemented in the script host. Does not prove full text quality, book ordering, unique occurrences or consistency of scientific claims. FULL TeX/PDF remain generated-artifact blockers. This record is not independent review or V3 attestation.
